title: Tailwise Pharmacy Fill Billing Basis
content:
*Pharmacy billing.*

## Basis

1. **Merchandise subtotal.** A Tailwise Pharmacy fill is billed at the package's catalog price on the dispense date multiplied by the packages dispensed.
2. **First-pharmacy-order discount.** A one-time fill of a customer new to the pharmacy takes the class's first-pharmacy-order discount percentage off the merchandise subtotal, capped at the class's discount cap. A customer is new to the pharmacy when no pharmacy fill on any of the customer's prescriptions is dated within the class's lookback, counted in calendar days ending the day before the fill. The discount applies once per customer, to the first fill only, and never to Autoship fills, which take the Autoship discount instead.
3. **Service fee.** The service fee is the class's compounding fee on a compounded fill plus the adult-signature fee when it is due.
4. **Amount billed.** The amount billed on the fill is the merchandise subtotal less the discount, plus the shipping fee, plus the service fee.
5. **Rounding.** Amounts round half up to the cent; the discount is the lower of the percentage amount and the cap, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked examples (hypothetical prices; class figures from the discount and fee table)

| | Example A | Example B | Example C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Class | Rx Preventive | Rx Maintenance Medication | Rx Compounded Medication |
| Channel and customer | one-time order, first fill, new to the pharmacy | one-time order, first fill, new to the pharmacy | one-time order, existing pharmacy customer |
| Packages and price | 2 at $54.99 | 1 at $36.50 | 1 at $48.00 |
| Merchandise subtotal | $109.98 | $36.50 | $48.00 |
| Discount | 20 percent is $21.996, held to the $20.00 cap: $20.00 | 20 percent: $7.30 | none |
| Shipping fee (from the shipping terms) | $0.00 | $4.95 | $9.95 |
| Service fee | $0.00 | $0.00 | $12.50 compounding fee |
| Amount billed | $89.98 | $34.15 | $70.45 |

## Points of judgement

- An Autoship fill never takes the first-pharmacy-order discount, even when it is the customer's first pharmacy fill.
- A second fill of a customer new to the pharmacy takes no discount: the discount attaches to the first fill only.
- A customer whose last pharmacy fill, on any prescription, is dated within the lookback is not new to the pharmacy.
